fields.description: Titania brings studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments to Majan. A tall residential stack rises above podium parking, with a family-oriented leisure deck. Its own plans show why the balcony contribution matters when comparing homes with the same bedroom count.

sources.label: Official-linked own brochure and embedded plans
Property Finder: Titania project dates and payment summary

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Titania page, brochure and facts reviewed; 789 residential homes distinguished from current inventory.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page confirms Majan, Dubai; brochure map is indicative, not a cadastral plot coordinate.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own studio / one / two-bedroom mix reviewed, with numerical sample plans from each family.
reviewCoverage.areas: Own 33-page brochure plans on pages 22, 24 and 27 visually inspected at 1750 px; suite/balcony/total labels checked.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own page and facts confirm family leisure deck facilities, with access and final delivery subject to contract.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Current retrieved own hero FROM 679,999 separated from indexed regional inventory and portal price bases.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own retrieved documents contain no dated commercial calendar; Property Finder 10/40/50 attributed, not a universal current offer.
reviewCoverage.handover: Property Finder February/Q1 2027 forecast recorded as portal target only; no official unit handover evidence retrieved.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own linked brochure and facts downloaded from public Binghatti S3 mirror; no separate signed payment or completion document found.

overview: Start with the selected apartment’s enclosed accommodation, then compare its outdoor area and floor position. The published building schedule is not a substitute for a unit plan and sale agreement.
research.locationNote: Majan, Dubai, near Al Barari and the E 311 road network. Exact outlook and journey times depend on the home and route.
research.priceNote: The retrieved developer hero displays a reference from AED 679,999. Its indexed UK inventory instead lists studios from AED 688,999, while Property Finder quotes a much higher launch/FAQ basis around AED 1.46 m. These are different published references; none confirms an available unit or a binding offer.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10% at launch, 40% during construction and 50% on handover. The retrieved own brochure and facts do not provide a dated instalment calendar. This third-party summary must be replaced by the selected unit’s written terms before committing.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives February 2027, within Q1 2027. This is a forecast rather than evidence of completion or key delivery. The retrieved developer FAQ does not supply a project completion date, so no precise contractual date is asserted.

facts.label: Published residential mix
facts.value: 789 homes: 473 studios, 284 one-bedroom apartments and 32 two-bedroom apartments. These are design counts, not available stock.

facts.label: Building schedule
facts.value: Official facts specify 3 basements, ground, 4 podiums, 32 residential floors, a mechanical floor and roof. The FAQ’s shorthand floor count uses a different convention.

unresolved: Current inventory, selected-unit prices, dated instalments and contractual handover require written developer confirmation. No service-charge estimate, unit-specific parking allocation or furnishing inclusion was established.

Areas are brochure examples including outdoor space, not net usable interiors. Rounded printed totals are retained; use the sale agreement for the exact unit. Floor, orientation, material and amenity illustrations can vary.
